operations.description: Read one presentation by presentationId: its slides, layouts, masters and their elements; narrow it with fields to stay under the engine's 4 MiB response limit
Read one page of a presentation by presentationId and pageObjectId, with its page elements

Read a page thumbnail's contentUrl, width and height; the image behind contentUrl is not fetched. contentUrl gives anyone holding it the requester's access to the image for about 30 minutes: treat it as a credential and do not log or share it
Create a blank presentation from the body's title, and presentationId if one is given; Google ignores every other body field. Unguarded: nothing exists to compare before a create

Apply body.requests atomically to a presentation whose current revisionId equals the pinned body.writeControl.requiredRevisionId, which is required; Google checks that revision again when it applies them. A fields value must keep presentationId, otherwise an applied write is reported unknown. createImage, replaceImage and replaceAllShapesWithImage store their URL in the deck as Image.sourceUrl, readable by every viewer: never pass a getThumbnail contentUrl as an image URL. Comment requests (Developer Preview) can fail on a 200 that is reported applied: read commentUpdateState in the answer
